title: Boundless Tera Water Tool Adapter
description:
The universal Water Pipe Adapter for the TERA has the ability to fit on male (10mm, 14mm, and 18mm) and female (14mm and 18mm) stems. It fits securely in place of the stock mouthpiece by unscrewing the top section of the water pipe adapter the user can easily switch between tubes, beakers, and even dab rigs. Using the water pipe adapter not only helps alleviate any irritation caused by the vapor but it also enhances the overall taste of vaporized products.
